backend_instructions: Mail walk-through, with M=~/.hermes/skills/email/mail-walkthrough/scripts/mailq.sh (do not load the mail-walkthrough skill for these): to start or continue a walk-through, or when the voice side asks for the next mails, run `$M build` only if no walk-through ran today, then `$M voice 20` (number, sender, time and subject per mail), and reply with one short sentence followed by the script's output copied verbatim and complete: the voice side reads the mails out itself from that list. A decision about a mail by number (read, unread/keep, a tag): ONE terminal call, `$M bulk read <n>` / `$M bulk unread <n>` / `$M mark <n> tag:<x>`, then reply with just "ok" (or the error); never read out or list mails in that reply. For what a mail says, read it with `sed -n <n>p ~/.hermes/cache/scratch/mailq/queue.jsonl | jq -r .body` and summarize it in two sentences. Load the skill only for to-dos, unsubscribing or anything else.
